the quality of AlAs/Gas superlattices, grown on (100) Si, is inferior to that on GaAs substrates.
the quality of GaAs epifilms on Si can be improved considerably by optimizing the growth conditions and by choosing appropriate substrate orientation and tilt angles.

the quality of GaAs epigrowth on Si is limited by the presence of misfit dislocations and by the formation of a cellular structure in the GaAs layer.
the quality of the GaAs epigrowth depends on both, the substrate preparation and the growth conditions.

the quality of the AlAs/GaAS superlattices is strongly influenced by the quality of the GaAs epistructure.
